name: Duergar-Occupied Hold
description: The lower halls of Ironfast Outpost, now controlled by gray dwarves.

barricade.title: Dwarven Barricade
barricade.description: The dwarves have erected a hasty barricade of rubble and iron beams. Beyond, the dark halls are controlled by the duergar. Commander Thrain nods grimly as you prepare to breach.

upper_hall.title: Upper Hall
upper_hall.description: A wide hall carved from living stone. Dwarven carvings depicting battles and forges line the walls. Signs of recent combat are everywhere—blood, broken weapons, scorched stone.

encounters.description: Three duergar warriors block your path!

armory.title: Ransacked Armory
armory.description: The dwarven armory has been thoroughly looted. Empty weapon racks and shattered display cases are all that remain.

barracks.title: Slaughter Hall
barracks.description: The dwarven barracks. Bunks are overturned, and the floor is stained with blood. The dwarves fought desperately here.

forge_level.title: The Great Forge
forge_level.description: A massive chamber housing the dwarven forge. The fires are cold now, the anvils silent. The duergar have desecrated this sacred place.

deep_vault.title: Deep Vault of Ironfast
deep_vault.description: The deepest chamber of the hold, where the dwarves kept their greatest treasures. Grathak the Soulless stands before the open vault, a serpent amulet glowing on his chest. Behind him, duergar warriors form a shield wall.

encounters.description: Grathak the Soulless and his elite guard turn to face you! Dark energy crackles around Grathak's war pick!
